gappers.analysis_details:
• **The Beats (Surprise Factor)**
Neogen Corporation reported **first-quarter results** for fiscal year 2027 that **exceeded analyst expectations**. The company demonstrated **strong sales**, leading to the stock being up **8%** in after-hours trading, reversing previous losses.

• **The Growth (Momentum)**
Sales for the quarter **rose 6.5%**, indicating robust top-line expansion for the food safety solutions company. This growth occurred despite Neogen reporting an **$11.9 million loss** for the period, with investors focusing on the positive sales momentum.

• **The Guide**
Neogen further bolstered investor sentiment by **raising its full-year guidance**. This updated outlook signals management's confidence in sustained business momentum and future financial performance, which is a critical indicator for momentum investors.
